answer.thought: The headlines sit on the step like dead leaves. Kerala building a temple for pilgrims while Calcutta courts criminalize a man's speech; the state asserting its power in both directions, yet the ethical substance remains elusive. The vaccine statistic is a dry fact, the contempt case a hot argument. I will note the tension between the universal claim of the state and the particular passions of its citizens, but first I must attend to the body that reads them.
